kind: a new behaviour that runs only on a physical device

pull_requests.title: feat(boost): add a boost command that heats at full power for a while
pull_requests.body: hearthctl boost tells the thermostat to heat at full power for 30 minutes and then return to its programme. The thermostat takes BOOST <seconds>. It needs the thermostat connected over USB.

pull_requests.title: feat(boost): let boost take --minutes
pull_requests.body: hearthctl boost --minutes N boosts for N minutes instead of the default 30.
